text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Saddam attacks United States, says Washington not only targeting him and his colleaques but also Iraq as nation.
- Iraq moves to expose Washington's role in region during Islamic conference in Islamabad.
- Washington warns against further bomb attacks on its installations in Saudi Arabia.
- General strike in Lebanon for pay rise.
- Foreign Minister Sahaf meets Jordanian deputy prime minister.
(The above were also carried by AL-IRAQ and THAWRA)
- Commentary urges world public opinion to stand up against Israeli attitude towards Jerusalem.
- Moscow says it will implement oil deal with Iraq regardless of U.N. trade sanctions.
- Commentary attacks Iran for keeping Iraqi POWs.
